gwt.given: an output parameter collection that already contains a parameter named '@ExistingId', and an ignoreParameters set that does not contain '@ExistingId'
gwt.when: CreateOutputParameters<TModel> is called on that collection, passing that ignoreParameters set
gwt.then: after the call returns, the ignoreParameters set contains '@ExistingId' even though the caller never added it — every parameter name already present in the incoming collection is merged into ignoreParameters before the model's output-parameter delegate is invoked, and the same parameter collection is returned

sources.label: CreateOutputParameters merges pre-existing parameter names into ignoreParameters
